confidence_notes: Restaurant and food anchors are medium confidence. They are bounded by a few Kenting-specific travel-blog figures and Taipei cost-of-living aggregates, which disagree and mix dates. The midrange two-person meal is the weakest food anchor, since it rests on one aggregator average with a wide range. Cocktail and wine are low confidence: no Kenting bar prices were found, so cocktail uses Taipei bar ranges adjusted down for a resort town, and wine uses the beer-to-wine relationship. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and the city context; no booking pages or current listings were inspected and no accommodation searches were run. Peak-season resort rates may sit well above these figures.
comparable_city_reasoning: Basis is Taiwan's price level, using Taipei restaurant, coffee, beer and cocktail ranges and southern Taiwan regional prices, adjusted for Kenting as a beach-resort town where drinks and seafood cost more than in local neighbourhood eateries. Cocktail and wine are scaled from local beer and Taipei bar ranges because direct Kenting data was weak. Exchange conversion uses roughly NT$31–32 per USD.
